description: Calibration plan fixtures of task T047. The plans array holds valid artifacts; each one that carries a content_hash states its computed self-hash in the plan domain, which one implementation of the hashing contract outside the Rust core computed. The facts object states the derived facts of every valid plan: its computed identity, its candidate count, the head of the candidate enumeration in the declared order, its objective, its confidence level, and its denominator names. The invalid array holds artifacts that Rust must reject with the stated reason code and field path, before any dataset is read. The bindings array pairs valid plans with one loaded definition, one fitting and one validation split identity of the shared datasets, or the registered evaluators: those failures are binding failures before any fitting runs. A row states its plan under plan_id or plan, its split selections under fitting and validation, where other: names the second dataset, and the failure is absent when the pairing loads.
